scope: Separate exploratory DNE-only and TULIP-only experiments; no combined data.

selectors.corr_rf_importance: constant removal and abs(Spearman rho)>=0.95 filter fitted on outer training fold; RF mean decrease impurity importance fitted on outer training participants; top-k; correlated features can bias/split importance
selectors.l1_logistic: constant removal, StandardScaler and L1 LogisticRegression(C=1.0, class_weight='balanced', solver='liblinear') fitted on outer training participants; top-k by absolute coefficient

probability_interpretation: predict_proba-derived uncalibrated scores, not clinical probabilities
note: No model artifacts saved. DNE results are exploratory internal reanalysis with collection/session confounding. TULIP results are exploratory only and are not independent external validation.
